new:
for fname in MEMORY_FILES:
        fpath = mem_dir / fname
        status, lines = file_fill_status(fpath)
        note = ""
        # 判据修正（2026-09-22 实测）：结构类文件仍停留在「未运行 sync」模板占位时不得算 filled。
        # 旧口径只数非空行，模板的 `## 模块说明` + 2 条空列表项恰好凑够 3 行阈值 → 误判 filled，
        # 而同日 review 判其「尚未运行 sync，目录树为空」，同文件两子命令结论相反。
        if fname in STRUCTURAL_FILES and status != "missing" and is_sync_placeholder(ensure_utf8_read(fpath)):
            status = "empty"
            note = "needs sync（未运行 sync，仍为模板占位）"
        if status == "filled":
            filled_count += 1
        icon = status_icons.get(status, "?")
        if not note and fname in STRUCTURAL_FILES and status == "filled":
            content = ensure_utf8_read(fpath)
            note = "auto-synced" if "SYNC_AUTO_GENERATED" in content else "manually edited"
        elif not note and status == "partial":
            note = "needs more content"
        elif not note and status == "empty":
            note = "needs filling"
        print(f"{fname:<30} {icon} {status:<9} {lines:<8} {note}")
